selection_method: Whole 2020 Census block groups whose polygon intersects the adopted Fenton Village (FV) Overlay Zone. Spatial selection, joined by GEOID, never by name. These three cover 100% of the study area; no other block group intersects it.
selection_reproduction: scripts/verify_geography.py (requires shapely; not run at build or startup)
counts_describe: Each whole block group, not the Fenton Village study area. Only 5.7%-31.4% of each block group lies inside the study area, so these counts must never be summed into a Fenton Village total.
